directions.title: Two eclipses. Two shadows.
directions.tensionHook: One hides the Sun. The other turns the Moon red.
directions.promise: Understand which body blocks the light and which receives the shadow.
directions.payoff: Solar means Moon shadow on Earth; lunar means Earth shadow on Moon.
directions.visualApproach: Original space illustrations, moving alignments and shadow sweeps

directions.title: Why not every month?
directions.tensionHook: The Moon circles Earth every month. Why not a monthly eclipse?
directions.promise: Explain the role of orbital inclination.
directions.payoff: The shadows usually miss because the orbital planes differ.
